text: うますぎて　かえれん！

patterns.name: 〜すぎる
patterns.explanation: すぎる added to a describing word means 'too much so'; its て-form here gives the reason for what follows. うますぎて = 'it's so tasty that'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: かえれる is the 'can' form of かえる 'go home'. With the 'not' ending ん, かえれん = 'I can't go home'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ん is a rough, shortened form of ない 'not', common in men's and older people's speech. かえれん = 'can't go home'.
